what: Covers the whole screen in amber CRT glass — scanlines every 3px (shade .17), a 4px vertical grid (.085), edge darkness (pow .22, .18) and shoulders (inside 10% of the edges .13) are laid down as shade. Every 9.1s (.11/s) a light band (width 1/14, accent ×1.8×.05) sweeps from bottom to top, with grain (.07) added. Brightness flickers as 1+.05·sin(43t)·(.55+.45·sin(13.7t)), and outside the corner radius of 2.8% of screen height (16~32px) a bezel (base .3) blocks the view. Drawn at 30fps, and presses pass through underneath

options.radius: Corner radius (ratio of screen height), default .028 — 0 gives a square screen (never shrinks below 16px)
options.screen: If off, covers only inside the attached element instead of the full screen

note: In Chrome with HTML-in-Canvas support, the original captures the page as a texture, draws it bent into a barrel shape and reverse-maps input coordinates. This part is the voile mode the original uses in other browsers — the text is not warped

from.where: All pages shared.js — overlay-mode shader of the original crt module (scanlines 2.0944 · grid 1.5708 · light band .11 · ×14 · grain .07 · vignette .22 · shoulder .13 · reflection (.32,.86) · flicker 43/13.7Hz · 30fps)
